paper_statement: On the standard Elasticity benchmark, Geo-NeW obtains 0.351e-2 error, a 29% reduction from LaMO at 0.50e-2.
source_anchor: main.tex, Section 4.4 and Table 2; Appendix Table 5 and Table 6
assumptions: The standard 1000-train/200-test Elasticity split and 972-node meshes are used.
The reported derived von Mises quantity and mean per-sample normalized L2 metric are used.
Geo-NeW uses P=32 and the paper's 10000-epoch configuration.
The released preprocessing exactly matches the paper's model inputs.

acceptance.verified: Independent evaluation of a released checkpoint, or adequately powered faithful retraining, reproduces both the absolute error and reduction under the exact split and metric.
acceptance.falsified: A faithful evaluation or adequately powered faithful retraining satisfying every assumption contradicts the result.

required_inputs: exact training configuration including optimizer details
released Elasticity checkpoint or feasible faithful retraining
rejection_rule: A scalar proxy, source-table audit, toy geometry, or alternative architecture cannot decide the claim.
